Aiden —

Thanks again for the time earlier this week. Per our conversation, I’m kicking off the renewal activation for ScaleGrid so we can scope the term amendment, confirm the uplift, and schedule a QBR to finalize capacity and onboarding steps. High-level plan below; please review and confirm who on your side should be looped into the technical and procurement calls.

Goal: finalize amended terms and secure signed amendment by end of June; launch staging burst in July.

Proposed next steps (target dates):
- Week of Jun 5: Technical sync (30–45m) to validate burst profile and KV caching expectations.
- Jun 12–14: Commercial review (pricing/term language) with Procurement & Legal.
- Jun 19: QBR with execs + review of runbook and SLOs (60m).
- Jun 26: Sign amendment and confirm staging start date.

Immediate asks for you: please share the primary procurement contact and confirm if the billing entity is still ScaleGrid, Inc. Also attaching the May usage export and a first-draft amendment we’ll iterate on.

Attachments: ScaleGrid_usage_report_May2028.csv, proposed_amendment_v1.pdf, QBR_agenda_draft.odt

Aiden — can you pick two windows (60m each) the week of Jun 19 that work for your execs? We’ll send calendar invites once we lock.

Thanks,
Marissa

marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0183
